title: 군사법원서기ㆍ군검찰수사관 및 검찰서기의 전형에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 군사법원서기ㆍ군검찰수사관 및 검찰서기의 전형에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Establishment of Committee for Selection of Clerks, etc.)
(1) A Committee for Selection of Clerks (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") shall be established within the Office of the Director General for Legal Affairs Management of the Ministry of National Defense to conduct selection examinations for clerks.
(2) The Committee shall consist of not more than eight members, including one Chairperson.
(3) The Chairperson shall be the Director General for Legal Affairs Management of the Ministry of National Defense. Members shall be appointed by the Minister of National Defense from among military legal officers and shall include one military legal officer designated by the Chief of Staff of each armed service.
(4) The Committee's affairs shall be handled, under the Chairperson's orders, by a secretary appointed by the Chairperson from among employees of the Office of the Director General for Legal Affairs Management, a military court, or the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office. <Amended on January 3, 2023.>
